[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 8: End-of-Round (EOR) Rules[/head][/color]
[color=#a4885c]8.1[/color] End-of-Round Griefing (EORG) is strictly prohibited under all circumstances. This includes, but is not limited to, engaging in combat, using explosives or hazardous chemicals, destroying property, or committing any other disruptive or malicious actions. ★
[color=#a4885c]8.2[/color] The End-of-Round (EOR) period begins 10 minutes after the round-end evacuation announcement (shuttle evacuation announcement). This grace period exists to allow players sufficient time to secure or recover their ships without interference.
